bindings.varsNote: These are the runtime flags that decide what Production actually does, so they belong in the manifest rather than only in wrangler.jsonc. TRAFFIC_SOURCE_MODE=PBS_ONLY stops every TDX API call; LINE_PUSH_POLICY=MAJOR_ACCIDENT_ONLY narrows proactive LINE push to accidents; PBS_AI_DECISION_ENABLED gates Windows PBS AI driver-impact decisions (must be the string 'true' to activate, never a bare JSON boolean -- Cloudflare injects Workers Variables as strings). All three are substituted from wrangler.jsonc by the export script, never hardcoded here. V2.0.2: PBS_AI_DECISION_ENABLED's canonical source moved from a Dashboard-only Variable (silently dropped by every Workers Builds deploy) to this wrangler.jsonc declaration -- see PRODUCT_DECISIONS.md / 07_KNOWN_ISSUES.md for the Config Drift Hotfix history. V2.4.0 added three granular switches (TDX_ROADEVENT_FETCH_ENABLED/TDX_ROADEVENT_QUEUE_INGRESS_ENABLED/TDX_CCTV_METADATA_REFRESH_ENABLED, all default "false"); V2.4.1 added a fourth, TDX_ROADEVENT_PRODUCTION_NOTIFY_ENABLED (also default "false" when first built). As of 2026-09-01 (V2_4_1_PRODUCTION_NOTIFY_CANONICAL_RECONCILIATION), FETCH/QUEUE_INGRESS/PRODUCTION_NOTIFY are all "true" under explicit human authorization -- a TDX-origin AI notify:true event can now reach a real LINE push/CCTV prepare/R2 publish. TDX_CCTV_METADATA_REFRESH_ENABLED remains "false" (CCTV metadata refresh stays manual/on-demand). NOTE: this table was NOT kept in sync with wrangler.jsonc during the Phase A/Phase B rounds earlier the same day (each of those rounds only updated SYSTEM_STATE.json, per its own minimal-scope directive) -- this entry is the first point this file reflects the real values; see SYSTEM_STATE.json's own taskSeal/phase history for the true chronology.
